scope: src/docker_isolation.py and isolated synthetic development helper
implemented: Pinned sha256 Linux image; no pull, shell, inherited host secrets or credential config
Local Docker Desktop named pipe only; explicit empty dedicated Docker config
Read-only runtime bind and root filesystem, offline network namespace, non-root UID/GID, no capabilities, no-new-privileges
Daemon inspect before start checks exact limits, entrypoint, image, mounts, environment and ownership labels
Two PID slots reserved for trusted PID1 supervisor and one untrusted worker
Bounded stdout plus stderr; fixed wall, cancellation and command timeouts
Independent host pipe-lease watchdog, supplemented by immutable in-container PID1 wall supervisor
Owned container stop, daemon Running=false/Pid=0 readback and remove required before cleanup_complete=true
Linux VM PID scope explicit; it is never reported as a Windows worker PID
